title: VPN authentication failure
description: User cannot login to VPN after password reset. MFA push is not received.
resolution: Verified MFA sync, reset VPN profile, and confirmed AD password propagation.

title: Airflow DAG failed after schema change
description: Daily ETL DAG failed because the upstream source added a new nullable column.
resolution: Updated dbt model, reran Great Expectations validation, and triggered Airflow backfill.

title: AWS Lambda timeout
description: Lambda function times out while processing S3 event payloads.
resolution: Increased timeout, optimized payload parsing, and added CloudWatch alerting.

title: Database connection timeout
description: Application logs show repeated PostgreSQL connection timeout errors.
resolution: Checked connection pool limits, restarted service, and increased max connections.

title: Suspicious login activity
description: Multiple failed login attempts detected from unusual location.
resolution: Disabled account, reviewed logs, forced password reset, and created security incident.

title: Kubernetes deployment stuck
description: New service deployment is stuck in pending state due to image pull errors.
resolution: Validated image repository credentials, fixed the deployment manifest, and redeployed.

title: User cannot access production database
description: Service account receives permission denied while querying the analytics database.
resolution: Reviewed IAM policy, granted required read permissions, and verified connection.

title: Delayed dashboard refresh
description: Business intelligence dashboards are not updating after the nightly ETL run.
resolution: Tracked the failed job, reran the pipeline, and fixed the stale refresh schedule.

title: Firewall rule blocks API traffic
description: External API calls are rejected by new firewall rules after the network change.
resolution: Updated firewall filter to allow the service CIDR and tested traffic flow.

title: Service exception after authentication change
description: Application throws an auth token validation error after identity provider update.
resolution: Rolled back the auth integration change, audited token issuance, and patched the client library.

title: Cloud storage bucket not accessible
description: Automated backup job cannot write to the S3 bucket due to ACL restrictions.
resolution: Adjusted bucket policy, validated IAM role access, and reran the backup.

title: Identity sync failure
description: Active Directory synchronization is failing for a batch of new users.
resolution: Examined sync logs, corrected invalid attributes, and restarted the sync pipeline.

title: SSL certificate expired
description: Public-facing service is returning certificate expired warnings.
resolution: Rotated the certificate, updated the load balancer, and verified browser access.

title: Disk pressure on production node
description: A compute node is reporting high disk usage and OOM warnings.
resolution: Cleaned temporary files, resized storage, and tuned retention policies.

title: Cluster monitor alert for CPU spike
description: Monitoring alerts show sustained CPU spikes in the order processing cluster.
resolution: Investigated consumer load, optimized queries, and adjusted autoscaling thresholds.

title: Failed SSO login
description: Single sign-on logins fail for users in the EU region.
resolution: Fixed the SAML configuration, restarted the auth provider, and confirmed login flow.

title: Suspicious API key usage
description: High volume of requests from a service account outside normal usage patterns.
resolution: Revoked the compromised key, issued a new one, and initiated an incident response.

title: Broken ETL job after schema migration
description: The warehouse load job fails because the target table schema changed.
resolution: Updated the ingest transformation, reran the migration checks, and restarted the job.

title: Unexpected 500 errors in checkout
description: Checkout endpoint returns 500 after an application dependency upgrade.
resolution: Rolled back the dependency, captured stack traces, and applied a hotfix patch.

title: Data retention job missed schedule
description: Monthly cleanup did not run and old records were not purged.
resolution: Reset the scheduler, reran the retention job, and documented the corrective action.

title: Airflow task hung after database migration
description: A DAG task is waiting indefinitely on a lock held by a schema migration process.
resolution: Released the lock, updated task retry policy, and coordinated with DB migration owners.

title: Role authorization failure
description: Service role is denied access to the secrets manager after policy changes.
resolution: Reviewed role bindings, restored policy permissions, and verified access.

title: DNS outage for internal API
description: Internal service calls fail because the internal DNS resolver cannot resolve the service name.
resolution: Restarted DNS caching services, corrected zone entries, and verified cluster discovery.

title: Pipeline checkpoint mismatch
description: Batch ingestion pipeline reports checkpoint state drift after data schema mismatch.
resolution: Validated schema contract, backfilled the missed window, and updated pipeline monitoring.

title: Production job queue backlog
description: Message queue backlog grows and downstream workers cannot keep up.
resolution: Scaled worker nodes, tuned queue retention, and optimized message processing.

title: Identity provider certificate rotated
description: New identity provider certificate caused SSO failures for the mobile app.
resolution: Updated the SSO trust bundle, validated login flows, and communicated with affected teams.

title: Unexpected database deadlocks
description: High concurrency job triggers repeated deadlocks in the reporting database.
resolution: Identified conflicting transactions, rewrote queries, and adjusted isolation levels.

title: Unauthorized port scan detected
description: Network security logs show repeated port scans against internal services.
resolution: Blocked malicious IPs, escalated to the incident response team, and audited firewall rules.

title: GraphQL query latency spike
description: A high-volume GraphQL query is causing latency spikes and slow page loads.
resolution: Cached expensive fields, optimized query execution, and added rate limiting.

title: Alert on failed container health check
description: Container health checks are failing due to an application startup delay.
resolution: Increased readiness timeout, fixed startup configuration, and redeployed the service.

title: Onboarding portal access denied
description: New employees cannot access the onboarding portal due to a missing role assignment.
resolution: Added the missing role mapping, verified access, and updated identity provisioning rules.

title: Backup restore failing due to checksum error
description: A restore job for archived files fails with a checksum mismatch.
resolution: Verified backup integrity, rehydrated from a stable snapshot, and updated the restore script.

title: Critical security patch not applied
description: A vulnerability scan finds one production host missing the latest patch.
resolution: Applied the patch, restarted the host, and confirmed the system is no longer vulnerable.

title: Data warehouse query timeout
description: Analyst queries are timing out in the warehouse during peak hours.
resolution: Optimized the slow query, added indexes, and reviewed resource classes.

title: Alert for failing batch checkpoint
description: A nightly batch checkpoint fails and needs manual intervention.
resolution: Reset the checkpoint state, retried the batch, and added guardrails.

title: PCI compliance scanning error
description: Credentialed scan is failing on a set of application endpoints.
resolution: Whitelisted the scanner IPs, confirmed authorized test access, and reran the scan.

title: Cache invalidation not happening
description: Users are seeing stale content because cache invalidation is not firing after deploy.
resolution: Diagnosed the invalidation hook, fixed the webhook payload, and cleared stale entries.

title: Failed service restart
description: A critical service fails to start due to missing environment variables after deployment.
resolution: Restored the environment spec, restarted the service, and verified health checks.

title: Suspicious privilege escalation attempt
description: Audit logs show a user trying to access privileged resources outside approval.
resolution: Blocked the account, investigated the activity, and tightened access controls.

title: Data ingestion pipeline lagging
description: Streaming ingestion falls behind because the producer keyspace is hot.
resolution: Scaled the ingestion cluster, partitioned the hot keyspace, and reduced lag.

title: Service deployment rollback
description: Deployment was automatically rolled back after repeated health check failures.
resolution: Analyzed the release, fixed the bad configuration, and deployed a stable version.

title: Email alerts not sent
description: Incident notifications are not being delivered due to SMTP service failures.
resolution: Restarted the SMTP connector, validated credentials, and tested notification delivery.

title: Unauthorized database query pattern
description: A data access policy violation was detected in an internal BI report.
resolution: Revoked the query permission, alerted the report owner, and logged the policy violation.

title: Missing read access for analytics job
description: Analytics job fails because it cannot read from the source object storage bucket.
resolution: Fixed bucket ACLs, reauthenticated the job role, and resumed the run.

title: Identity provider latency alert
description: SSO performance alerts are raised when identity provider responses exceed thresholds.
resolution: Reviewed provider health, adjusted retry logic, and informed customer support.

title: Unauthorized cloud resource creation
description: A developer created an unauthorized VM outside approved environments.
resolution: Terminated the rogue resource, enforced policy guardrails, and reviewed approvals.

title: Source control merge conflict breaks deploy
description: A merge conflict caused the deployment pipeline to fail during release prep.
resolution: Resolved the conflict, reran the pipeline, and improved merge validation.

title: API gateway rate limit exceeded
description: Requests are being throttled by the gateway due to a burst of traffic.
resolution: Adjusted rate limit rules, added client retry guidance, and monitored traffic.

title: Stale secret detected in config
description: A secret manager audit found a stale credential still referenced in an app config.
resolution: Rotated the credential, removed the stale reference, and audited config scripts.

title: Latency regression after cache eviction
description: A production latency regression occurred after an unexpected cache eviction event.
resolution: Identified cache misconfiguration, restored warm cache state, and tuned eviction policies.
